1. you hid the dented biscuit tin behind grandma's water tank and swore it was full of stolen gold 2. so for three summers i guarded the path with a bamboo cane while the grown-ups talked inside 3. we sat on the back step splitting a bottle of warm orange squash, pretending we had a secret to protect 4. but on our last sunday before the long drive home, you pulled the tin out of the nettles and pushed it into my hands 5. there was no gold inside, just three smooth stones and a green plastic soldier with half a rifle missing 6. you said you made up the treasure so i wouldn't cry when my dad packed the suitcases into the boot 7. that little soldier is still on my desk, thirty years after grandma's house was sold
✍️ Caption
we spent two months of every year sharing bunk beds and drinking warm squash from plastic cups. then the car boot slammed shut and we had to go back to different towns. send this to the cousin who shared the fold-out couch with you every august. #childhoodmemories #nostalgia #grandmashouse #growinguptogether
